caption: The drawing presents a single object, which is a bonnet with intricate lace patterns. The bonnet is composed of delicate, light-colored fabric adorned with detailed, symmetrical designs that include floral motifs, circular and semi-circular shapes, and rows of small dots. The bonnet has curved edges and ties on the left and lower side, depicted with subtle, curved lines. The rest of the image consists of an empty, light-toned background with no additional objects or decorations. The artist’s signature, "H.A. Marsh," appears in the lower right corner of the drawing. The drawing uses subdued, monochromatic colors with light grays and beige tones throughout.
title: Baby's Cap
